Datenbanken – das Gedächtnis jeder App: Databases – the memory of every app
Wenn du Musik streamst, online bestellst: When you stream music, order something online or your school report is printed, a program asks a database in the background. It stores data in tables – organised so well that you can find the right thing in an instant, even among millions of rows. The program that manages the database is called a database management system (DBMS for short). In this course you use one of the most widely used in the world: SQLite. It is in almost every phone.
